annotations.title: Estimate a 2027 marketplace premium tax credit

description: Estimates a household's 2027 ACA premium tax credit the way the site's subsidy calculator does: poverty-line percentage, IRS applicable percentage (Rev. Proc. 2026-26), expected monthly contribution, the age-rated benchmark silver premium for the county, the monthly credit, net cost of the lowest bronze, silver and gold plans, the 400% cliff, and a per-person income screen for Medicaid, CHIP or a Basic Health Program. An estimate, not an eligibility decision.

annual_income.description: Expected 2027 household income (modified adjusted gross income) in dollars per year.

benchmark_monthly.description: Optional. The monthly price of the second-lowest-cost silver plan for the people applying, from HealthCare.gov or the state exchange. Replaces the county estimate; required for a credit in states that run their own exchange.

county.description: County name (e.g. "Harris" or "Harris County") or 5-digit county FIPS code.

members.description: Each person applying for coverage, e.g. [{"age":45},{"age":43,"pregnant":true},{"age":10}].

others_in_household.description: People on the tax return who are not applying (they count toward household size).

state.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. TX, CA, DC) or full state name.

name: estimate_premium_tax_credit
title: Estimate a 2027 marketplace premium tax credit
